Hi Elena —

Great to chat this morning. Thanks for the time and the clear context on your compliance needs and traffic profile. Quick recap and proposed next step:

Recap (1-line): Novacare is evaluating a private/VPC deployment to keep PHI within customer-controlled networks, with 99th percentile latency targets in the 150-200ms range for critical flows.

Next step: schedule a technical deep dive (architecture + ops runbook) with our infra lead and your network/security engineers. Goal: validate network prerequisites, KMS options, and a proof-of-concept timeline.

Proposed 60–90 minute slots (PT):
- Wed Jul 23 — 10:00–11:30
- Thu Jul 24 — 08:30–10:00
- Mon Jul 28 — 13:00–14:30

Please indicate the best option and who from your team will join (network, security, SRE).

Pre-call asks (attached):
- Network reachability matrix (CIDRs, NAT/GW details)
- VPN or Direct Connect preference
- KMS/HSM provider and key management flow
- Compliance evidence goals (retention, audit log access)

Attachment: priv-hosting-precall-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
Also linking a short prep doc: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1PrivPrepDocs

If none of these slots work we can open a poll — happy to adjust.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
